Is the solid-state battery bet, and this week it showed its next platform: Osprey, an open all-solid-state design with a ceramic separator and anode-free cells, with lab data of 1,000 cycles to about 80% and a 10-to-80% charge.

2121625783688982561.en_summary: $FLY This is the small launch company that just became an engine supplier: its deal with $ASTS is worth more than $1.3B — engines, a licence and three years of support — and its own launch backlog sits at $1.7B with the full-year guide just raised. Revenue beat last quarter.
